city_name: Marsa Alam & Wadi El Gemal, Egypt

routes.name: Hamata ↔ Qulaan Islands (Wadi El Gemal)
routes.description: The signature Marsa Alam run: a boat-only crossing from Hamata Marina to the protected Qulaan/Hamata islands inside Wadi El Gemal National Park — the same near-monopoly, boat-only access logic that anchors the Giftun corridors up the coast.
